jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a registered native-resolution top-down game terrain patch. Image 1 is the EXACT edit target: keep its framing, ground scale, palette, road centreline and edge connection positions. Image 2 is the approved camp road/earth artwork STYLE reference only, not its layout.
Repaint the artificial repeated strip road and its immediate shoulders as one coherent painted road-and-earth scene. Embed it into soil with uneven worn edges, subtle contact shadows, sparse whole stones, and firm finely textured earth. Remove tiny bead-like repeating stone borders, doubled/ghosted stones and repetitive streaks. Keep consistent camp stone scale: occasional main cobbles 25–48 source pixels, never shrink them into tiny paving as road narrows. Do not turn dirt trails into fully paved roads. No regular tile motifs.
Preserve surrounding terrain away from the road corridor. Preserve the outer 80-pixel border, especially the route crossing points, except localized repair of ghosted road joins. No camera change, resizing, crop, green tint, vegetation, new leaves, puddles, buildings, props, text or UI. Do not add roads. Full opaque image; soil blending, not transparent paving.
